assumptions: independent stationary repetitions; arbitrary dependence within each PUB shot unless explicitly bounded

hardware-model discrepancy and cost-model error remain unquantified

execution ceilings apply per job; their aggregate must preserve the declared reserve
explicit cost scenarios are sensitivity assumptions; their coverage of cost uncertainty is unquantified
optimization.scope: bounded routed candidates and uniform shot tiers; global optimality is unclaimed

exact_model.method: dynamic_density branch-resolved density matrix under the sampled run's Aer noise model
exact_model.validation: every exact probability within the simultaneous Hoeffding radius of its sampled frequency; each endpoint arm score and contrast within its own Hoeffding radius

covariance_falsifier.statistic: biased sample variance over shots of the weighted replica score sum Y = sum_k w_k s_k of one declared bound, w_k = term sign / replica count: an estimate of the projection w' Sigma w the radius reads
covariance_falsifier.upper_confidence_limit: UCL = statistic + eps2 + D eps1, with D = sum_k |w_k| (max score - min score), s = sqrt(ln(4 / t) / (2 n)), eps1 = D s, eps2 = (D^2 / 4) s, n the PUB's shots and t = tail / number of declared bounds; the true projection exceeds the UCL with probability at most t
covariance_falsifier.decision: each bound's radius reads the declared projection w' V w when its UCL is at or below it and the UCL otherwise, through Cantelli only where that is smaller than Hoeffding; an endpoint that reads any bound runs its confidence and detection radii at alpha minus the falsifier tails of the bounds it reads; absent or inconsistent registers leave every endpoint on the Hoeffding radius at the full alpha
covariance_falsifier.planning: the plan adds each bound's allowance at the planned shots to the declared projection, the variance collection reads when the sample variance equals the declared one, and spends the same falsifier tail
